description: Compare 2 to 4 colleges side by side: admit rates by round, SAT/ACT ranges, testing policy, sticker cost, average net price, graduation rate, size and setting. If GPA or scores are given, adds the student's estimated odds (same model as prefrosh.ai/chance).

gpa.description: Unweighted GPA, ideally on a 4.0 scale (a 100-point average also works).

home_state.description: Two-letter US state the student lives in (matters for public universities).
